content:
**Firecap Tasty Souffle** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Firecap mushrooms which have been mashed up with some spices and baked into little cakes.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Firecap (2) Pepper (2) Salt (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Firecap Souffle | | Firecap Tasty Souffle (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after the Recipe is learned.
